name: Put Blu Q to Bed — Deckhand
source: KB: haldo-kb-harvest §1F Put to Bed — Deckhand; 4.1 Waking up and Putting Blu Q to Bed, Evening > Deckhand
intro: End-of-day cleanup for Blu Q deckhand. Handle guest departure, cleaning, head treatment, trash, and food stowage. Scrub deck with Dawn and deck brush.

items.label: Guests disembark and put away any gear
Wash dishes and stow in correct drying racks
Clean, sanitize and fill water bottles
Fill Yeti water jug with filtered water
Scrub deck with Dawn, deck brush, using a trash or recycle can
Hang floor mats and anything that needs to dry
Stow main halyard / make all lines taut with preventers if needed
Wash and clean head and sink area
Put 2 oz of Blue in head and flush a gallon of fresh water from hose or bucket
Collect all trash and get trash ready to be emptied
After emptying trash, hose them out
Food leftovers go into Yeti coolers to ensure packaged food is not submerged in water
Check food inventory and pass on the information to following crew

completion.notes_prompt: Any cleaning issues? Supplies running low? Anything to flag for the next deckhand?
